rates.name: Listing Fee
rates.notes: $0.20 USD per listing or renewal, active for 4 months or until quantity sold

rates.name: Transaction Fee
rates.notes: 6.5% of the total item sale price plus shipping, gift wrapping, and personalization

rates.name: Payment Processing Fee (US)
rates.notes: 3.0% plus $0.25 USD on the total order amount processed via Etsy Payments

rates.name: Offsite Ads Fee (Standard)
rates.notes: 15% attributed fee for sellers under $10,000 USD in 12-month trailing sales (optional, can opt out)

rates.name: Offsite Ads Fee (High Volume)
rates.notes: 12% attributed fee for sellers with $10,000+ USD in 12-month trailing sales (mandatory, fee capped at $100 USD per order)

notes: Official Etsy Seller Fees Policy verified for US sellers, including listing, transaction (6.5%), Etsy Payments (3% + $0.25), and Offsite Ads (15% standard / 12% high volume).
